mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_order_log (order_id, from_status, to_status, event, operator_id, remark) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{event}, #{operatorId}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, from_status, to_status, event, operator_id, remark, create_time FROM tb_order_log WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id ASC
